title: UI风格#141 - Noir Photography (黑色摄影)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Photography style When color palette Then features pure black, pure white, silver gray, sepia tint
Given Noir Photography style When typography Then uses editorial fonts: Playfair Display, Lora, or Source Serif Pro
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Playfair Display (headers 2.2rem 600 weight), Lora (body 0.95rem 400-500 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Photography style When layout Then photo frames, film border, caption overlays, contact sheet
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: film grain SVG overlay, noir photography aesthetic with black/white/silver color scheme, darkroom styling

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Photography style When UI elements Then grain overlay, vignette shadows, developing tray, darkroom red
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: grain texture overlay, vignette-style dark backgrounds, darkroom red accent color, photography icons (📷◉◼◻▣◾)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Photography UI When functional Then includes darkroom chat, photographer agents, exposure stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: darkroom chat, 4 photographer agents (Dev Frame, RAG Lens, PM Focus, Test Negative) with Exposure/Aperture/Focus/Depth/Frame/Composition/ISO/Contrast stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Noir Photography UI When copy Then uses photographic: 'Exposure', 'Aperture', 'Darkroom', 'Frame'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'EXPOSURE. APERTURE. DARKROOM.', tagline '~ captured moments in shadow ~', button 'SNAP', greeting 'The shutter opens... the moment is captured. What story shall we develop?', status 'SHOOTING'/'IDLE', nav 'Darkroom'/'Snap'/'Develop'/'Gallery'
